core_policy: primary non-singing production + manual/manually corrected/exhaustively human-verified relevant annotations or measurements
registry_note: Base registries are supplemented by dated increment CSVs under data/registry/increments/. Append-only policy-correction increments supersede earlier decisions when scope conflicts are found.
warehouse_policy: preserve all source variables before harmonization; public download is not assumed to grant redistribution rights
warehouse_count_note: Current row/table counters include the validated PAVOQUE core parse (5 canonical YAML files; 5,442 core utterance rows + 246,386 manually corrected segment rows), the 45-row Coretta lexical lookup table, the complete 3,253-row Coretta formants-ids.csv linkage table, the complete 172-row Coretta stimuli.csv context table, and 1,800 durable source-faithful rows from Coretta measurements.csv. Coretta measurements.csv remains a partial logical table: rows 1-1,800 of 3,268 are durable and counted once; rows 1,801-3,268 remain pending. Its authoritative immutable-blob schema is 14 variables (speaker, ipu, stimulus, sentence_ons, sentence_off, word_ons, word_off, v1_ons, c2_ons, v2_ons, voice_ons, voice_off, c1_rel, c2_rel), and literal --undefined-- values remain unchanged. Full-table consolidation must supersede rather than duplicate partial chunks. Coretta lexical/linkage/stimulus rows are metadata/linkage observations and do not increase unique speech-token counts. The 1,892 PAVOQUE outtake utterance records are parsed and lineage-preserved but excluded from the core row counter. VoxAngeles decile trajectories remain canonical and quartile trajectories overlapping alternates; pending large TSV materialization is not yet added to warehouse counts.
